title: Shell Scripting
task: Finish check-config.sh. Given an existing file, it should print its contents and exit 0. Given a missing file, it should write missing config to stderr and exit 2. Record stdout from the good input in good.out, stderr from a missing file in bad.out, and both statuses on separate lines in exits.txt. The checker runs your script with a second set of paths.
hints: Inside the success branch use cat -- "$1".
Use printf with >&2 in the error path, then exit 2.

checks.label: The success output matches the config
checks.feedback: Capture stdout on the supplied good input.

checks.label: The missing-file message is on stderr
checks.feedback: Send the error to stderr and capture it using 2>.

checks.label: The script works on new input
checks.feedback: Check quoted input paths, stderr, and exit codes.

demo.explanation: Quote the path both when calling the script and inside it.
